title: Parent Conference Checklist
subtitle: Capture conference agenda, student work, attendance context, and family question; confirm agreed action and progress follow-up.
description: Parent Conference records conference agenda, student work, attendance context, family question, agreed action, and progress follow-up. Parent Conference evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this parent conference stage-gated verification when staff must document conference agenda and student work. Reconcile attendance context, family question, agreed action, and progress follow-up before the parent conference handoff. Use the conference invitation, work samples, gradebook snapshot, attendance record, teacher observations, family questions, action notes, and progress-review calendar. For parent conference live use, check roster. Reconcile the parent conference schedule and actual handoff times. Preserve the parent conference roster and schedule. Record the parent conference handoff time and instructions. Close the parent conference exception queue. Verify parent conference day-of-service timing. Resolve parent conference real-time changes and operating handoff for parent conference. Ask the assigned parent conference reviewer to confirm conference agenda against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Parent Conference starting details review
sections.guidance: Prepare agenda, student work samples, attendance and classroom context, family questions, agreed actions, communication preferences, and progress checkpoints.

sections.title: Parent Conference checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current parent conference facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Parent Conference required checks
items: Conference agenda is identified for this record
Student work matches the current request or source
Attendance context is ready for point-of-use staff
Family question limits or questions are resolved
Agreed action is communicated to the responsible person
Progress follow-up is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: Parent Conference failed or pending items

sections.title: Parent Conference readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold parent conference readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Parent Conference reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Parent Conference receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
